dogecoin.text: @elonmusk @dogecoin_devs I'd like to read about how any coin is working on becoming the coin of the people. Low fees, low fess low fees, easy adoption and conversion to fiat.

@elonmusk @dogecoin_devs As long as DOGE doesn't meet any of those standards, it's just another shit coin. Like all the others, yes, Bitcoin too. Useless in real life. Totally not what it was meant to do, nor what it was designed for.

@elonmusk @dogecoin_devs DOGE needs to do what none of the coins do, and that is to provide a road to full adoption. Gas prices need to be low or NIL. Pay for your coffee, your rent, your [whatever]. And it needs to offer a place where people who get paid in DOGE can convert to fiat.
